chapter.verse: A hang pen dahna tawh hong hawhkik ka hihloh ding ka lungsim ka khensat hi.
Note hong dahsak ka hihleh tua kong dahsakte longal kei hong lungdamsak ding kua om nawn ahi hiam?

Keima' nuamna pen note khempeuh ii lungdamna mah hiding cih na vekpi-un hong lungmuang ka hih manin kong tun ciangin kei hong lungdamsak ding ahizawte' tungpan dahna ka tuahkhak loh nadingin tua laikhak kong gelh ahi hi.

A hang pen nakpi lunggimna leh lungsim natna tawh khitui tampi luang kawmin kong gelh hi a, tua pen note kong dahsaknop man hilo-in note a tuam vilvelin hong it ka hihna thu kong theihsaknop man hizaw hi.
Tu-in mi khatpeuh in dah nading a bawl leh kei' tunga hong bawl hilo-in note khempeuh' tungah—a khauh lua lo-in ci lehang bangzah ciang hiam khat—hong bawl hizaw hi.
Tua bang mi' adingin mi a tamzawte' piak gawtna kicing lel hi.
Tua hi a, amah maisakin dinpihzaw un. Tua hikeileh amah dah lua-in lungbuaicip kha ding hi.
Tua ahih manin amah na itna uh lakkik un ci-in kong thum hi.
Hih kong gelhna a hang pen zong note na khempeuh ah thumang thumanglo cih hong sittelin kong theih nading ahi hi.
Mawhna na maisakte uh kei zong ka maisak ding hi. A taktakin (maisak ka neih leh zong) tua pen Khris' mai-ah note' ading ahi hi.
Tua hikeileh Satan in khemnop hong sa ding hi. (A hang pen ama' geelsim thute i theih loh hilo hi.)
Khris' Lungdamna Thu tangko dingin Troas khua ka tun ciangin Topa' min tawh kei' ading kongvang hong kihon ahih hangin
tua takah ka sanggampa Titus mu lo ka hih manin ka kha tawldam theilo hi. Tua hangin amaute nusia-in Macedonia gam ka paisuak hi.
Ahi zongin Khris hangin gualzawhna hong tunpih den, kote' tungtawnin mun citeng ah gimnamtui bangin amah theihna thu a kizelsak, Pasian' tungah lungdam ka ko hi.
Kote pen hotkhiat a ngah mite leh a kisia ding mite' adingin Pasian' tunga Khris' piak gimnamtui ka hi uh a,
khat' adingin sih gimnam, a dang khat' adingin hin gimnam ka hi uh hi. Hih thute a sem dingin kua tehcing ahi hiam?
Kote pen mi tampite bangin Pasian' thu a zuaksimte ka hikei uh a, Pasian' sawlna bangin ngimna siangtho tawh Pasian' mai-ah Khris' thu a gen ka hi uh hi.
